d: In this video, Firstpost examines Qualcomm’s reported layoffs in India, which could affect more than 1,000 employees across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi-NCR and Chennai. The cuts have left engineers facing an uncertain future, with some heartbreaking accounts emerging from affected employees. One worker reportedly learnt of their termination just days before their wedding. Another had spent years preparing for a career in semiconductor engineering. As Qualcomm restructures its global workforce, the layoffs raise serious questions about job security in India's technology sector. Gursshheen…
